+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboPaint limited-mode trajectory driver.
+
+Coordinate helpers and trajectory generation for painting the supplied target.
+The service episode is persistent; --calibrate performs only practice-sheet marks.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import math
+import pathlib
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
+DT = 0.05
+Z_TRAVEL = 0.075
+Z_PAINT = 0.0185
+Z_DIP = 0.023
+
+
+class Painter:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.r = Robot()
+        self.spec = self.r.spec()
+        st = self.spec['static']
+        self.wells = st['wells']['wells']
+        now = self.r.get_obs().meta['proprio']['now']
+        self.p = np.array(now[7:10], dtype=float)
+        self.q = np.array(now[10:14], dtype=float)
+        self.log = []
+
+    def pose(self, xyz):
+        return np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), self.q]
+
+    def send(self, rows, note='', cameras=('canvas_cam', 'side_cam'), video='none'):
+        rows = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)
+        if len(rows) == 0:
+            return None
+        result = None
+        # Each server chunk is limited to 10 s (200 rows at 20 Hz).
+        for start in range(0, len(rows), 198):
+            chunk = rows[start:start + 198]
+            result = self.r.submit('ee_pose', chunk, dt=DT, cameras=cameras,
+                                   video=video, video_fps=5, note=note)
+            self.p = chunk[-1, :3].astype(float)
+            self.log.append({'note': note, 'rows': int(len(chunk)), 'meta': result.meta})
+            print(json.dumps({'note': note, 'rows': len(chunk),
+                              'plan': result.meta.get('plan'),
+                              'time_left_s': result.meta.get('time_left_s')}), flush=True)
+        return result
+
+    def path(self, waypoints, hold_s=0.0, note='move', cameras=('canvas_cam', 'side_cam'), video='none'):
+        rows = []
+        pos = self.p.copy()
+        for wp in waypoints:
+            dest = np.asarray(wp, dtype=float)
+            n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(dest - pos) / 0.009)))
+            for k in range(1, n + 1):
+                rows.append(self.pose(pos + (dest - pos) * (k / n)))
+            pos = dest
+        if hold_s > 0:
+            rows.extend([self.pose(pos)] * max(1, int(math.ceil(hold_s / DT))))
+        return self.send(rows, note, cameras, video)
+
+    def well(self, i):
+        x, y = self.wells[i]['center_xy']
+        self.path([[x, y, Z_TRAVEL], [x, y, Z_DIP]], hold_s=0.35,
+                  note=f'dip-{i+1}')
+        self.path([[x, y, Z_TRAVEL]], note=f'lift-{i+1}')
+
+    def practice_stroke(self, i, start, end, label):
+        self.well(i)
+        self.path([[start[0], start[1], Z_TRAVEL],
+                   [start[0], start[1], Z_PAINT]], hold_s=0.15,
+                  note=f'{label}-touch', cameras=('practice_cam', 'side_cam'), video='frames')
+        result = self.path([[end[0], end[1], Z_PAINT]], hold_s=0.1,
+                           note=f'{label}-drag', cameras=('practice_cam', 'side_cam'), video='frames')
+        self.path([[end[0], end[1], Z_TRAVEL]], note=f'{label}-lift',
+                  cameras=('practice_cam', 'side_cam'))
+        if result:
+            result.save(str(OUT / f'calibration_{label}'))
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument('--calibrate', action='store_true')
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    p = Painter()
+    print(json.dumps({'initial': p.p.tolist(), 'time_left_s': p.r.get_obs().meta['time_left_s']}), flush=True)
+    if args.calibrate:
+        # Three 25 mm practice marks let us inspect the brush width and palette colour.
+        p.practice_stroke(0, [-0.095, -0.195], [-0.120, -0.195], 'white')
+        p.practice_stroke(5, [-0.090, -0.170], [-0.115, -0.170], 'blue')
+        p.practice_stroke(8, [-0.070, -0.195], [-0.095, -0.195], 'ochre')
+    (OUT / 'trajectory_log.json').write_text(json.dumps(p.log, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
*** End Patch";
